# WPSync

> WPSync is a command-line tool for managing WordPress blog posts as local Markdown files: map a folder to a blog, pull its posts, edit them in any editor, preview the differences, and push the changes back.

WPSync is for writers who would rather work in a Markdown editor, such as VS Code or Obsidian, than in the WordPress editor. Local files are the source of truth. Each post is a Markdown file under `content/` with a YAML header; images live in `content/images/` with paths relative to each post. New posts are private until marked public. Pull asks before replacing an edited file, and push asks before replacing a post that also changed on WordPress. Push deletes nothing unless `-p` / `--prune` is given; deleted posts are kept in the profile folder's `.trash/` and can be restored. WordPress is the first supported platform.
